title: World War I — Western Front
key_facts: Main theater of WWI between Germany and Allied forces
Characterized by trench warfare, stalemate, and massive casualties
Major battles: Marne (1914), Verdun (1916), Somme (1916), Passchendaele (1917)
Involved British, French, Belgian, and later American forces against Germany
causes: German Schlieffen Plan aimed at quick victory through Belgium
Allied resistance and rapid mobilization prevented German breakthrough
Industrial-scale weaponry led to defensive dominance and trench systems
outcome: Eventual Allied breakthrough in 1918 after German Spring Offensive failed
German withdrawal and armistice on November 11, 1918
Massive human cost: millions killed and wounded across all nations
impacts: Defined modern warfare with trenches, barbed wire, and machine guns
Led to massive social and political changes in participating nations
Created the 'Lost Generation' and profound cultural impact
